name: Firstalk: English from Zero
tagline: Learn English from zero with short lessons, listening and speaking practice explained in your own language — no account needed.
storage_summary: Your learning progress, review schedule, streak, goals and settings are stored only on your iPhone. Firstalk has no account and no server of its own. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone when your device supports it; otherwise the audio of the sentence you say is sent to Apple to be turned into text, and the app never saves recordings. Usage events go to Google Analytics for Firebase so we can fix problems and improve lessons; only if you allow tracking, they are also used to measure our Google Ads campaigns.
nothing_sent_detail: What you say in speaking exercises is never sent to us or to Google Analytics, and no recording is ever saved.

apple_speech.name: Apple Speech Recognition
apple_speech.purpose: Turns the English sentence you say in a speaking exercise into text so the app can check it. When your iPhone can recognize English on the device, the audio does not leave your iPhone. Otherwise Apple processes the audio on its servers.
apple_speech.data: the audio of the sentence you say in a speaking exercise, only when on-device recognition is not available, handled by Apple

apple_storekit.name: Apple (App Store purchases)
apple_storekit.purpose: Processes the Firstalk Pro subscription and verifies that it is active.
apple_storekit.data: your purchase receipt, handled by Apple (we never see your payment details, Apple Account or name)

firebase.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
firebase.purpose: Measures how the app is used (for example whether a lesson was finished or the upgrade screen was opened) and collects basic diagnostics so we can fix problems and improve lessons, and — only if you allow tracking — measures whether our Google Ads campaigns led to the app being installed or used, using Google's on-device conversion measurement. Firstalk has no account, so this data is never tied to your name or email. Firstalk does not use a separate crash-reporting service.
firebase.data: a small set of usage events and their settings (never what you say or type), an app-instance identifier (a device ID that may be used for ad measurement if you allow tracking), purchase events (product and result), basic diagnostic information such as app version, device model and OS version, locale, and an approximate region derived from your IP address (never your precise location); if you allow tracking in the App Tracking Transparency prompt, your advertising identifier (IDFA)

apple_ads.name: Apple Ads (Search Ads attribution)
apple_ads.purpose: Tells us whether Firstalk was installed after you tapped one of our ads in Apple Search Ads, so we can see which campaigns and keywords bring new learners. Apple's AdServices framework creates a one-time attribution token on your iPhone; it contains no name, email, advertising identifier or other personal details and works whether or not you allow tracking.
apple_ads.data: a one-time AdServices attribution token, from which Apple returns only campaign information (such as campaign, ad group and keyword) and whether an ad led to the install

adattributionkit.name: Apple AdAttributionKit (ad network attribution)
adattributionkit.purpose: Lets ad networks we advertise with, such as Google Ads, learn that one of their ads led to an install or a purchase. Apple sends these reports to the ad network itself, with a delay and in aggregated form, without any user or device identifier; it works whether or not you allow tracking.
adattributionkit.data: an anonymous, delayed attribution report created by Apple (which ad network and campaign, and a coarse conversion value such as whether a trial or purchase happened) — never your identity or device identifiers

data_sent.what: The audio of the sentence you say in a speaking exercise, only when your iPhone cannot recognize English on the device
data_sent.why: Turn your speech into text so the app can check it

data_sent.what: Usage events and purchase events (never what you say or type), an app-instance identifier, basic diagnostic information (app version, device model, OS version), locale, and an approximate region derived from your IP address; the advertising identifier (IDFA) only if you allow tracking
data_sent.why: Understand how the app is used, find problems, improve lessons and, only with your permission, measure our Google Ads campaigns

data_sent.what: A one-time Apple Ads attribution token (no personal details or device identifiers)
data_sent.why: Learn whether you installed Firstalk from one of our Apple Search Ads campaigns

data_sent.what: An anonymous, delayed install or purchase report created by Apple (no user or device identifier)
data_sent.why: Let ad networks such as Google Ads know that an ad led to an install
Confirm that your Firstalk Pro subscription is active

stored_on_device: Your learning progress, finished lessons, review schedule and streak.
Your settings, such as your explanation language, daily goal, reminder time and slow-audio preference.
Lesson audio is built into the app, so lessons work without an internet connection.
Erase your learning data at any time in Me → Settings → Delete learning data, or by deleting the app.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account, because Firstalk has no sign-in.
Voice recordings — the app never saves what you say.
Your precise location. Google Analytics for Firebase sees only an approximate region derived from your IP address (see above); the app never asks for location access.
Payment details — Firstalk Pro is bought through Apple, and we never see your card, Apple Account or name.
Your contacts, photos or browsing history.

permissions.name: Microphone
permissions.why: to hear the English sentences you say in speaking exercises. The microphone is used only while an exercise is listening, and nothing is recorded or saved. You can say no and keep learning with speaking exercises turned off.

permissions.name: Speech Recognition
permissions.why: to turn what you say into text and check it. Recognition runs on your iPhone when your device supports it; otherwise Apple processes the audio (see above).

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: to send the study reminder you choose and, if you start a free trial, a reminder before it ends. Nothing leaves your iPhone for this.

your_controls: **Delete your learning data** in **Me → Settings → Delete learning data**, or by deleting the app — everything lives only on your iPhone.
**Turn microphone, speech recognition or notifications off or on** in iOS Settings → Firstalk.
**Manage or cancel your subscription** in iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions.
**Allow or stop tracking** at any time in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking → Firstalk.

subscription.restore_location: on the Firstalk Pro screen, or in Me → Settings

support_faq.q: The app does not hear me.
support_faq.a: Firstalk needs microphone and speech recognition access. Open iOS **Settings → Firstalk** and turn on **Microphone** and **Speech Recognition**. Speak close to your iPhone in a quiet place.

support_faq.q: How do I change the explanation language?
support_faq.a: Open **Me → Settings → Explanation language**. The change applies right away.
Yes. Lessons and their audio are built into the app. Speech checking may need an internet connection on iPhones that cannot recognize English on the device.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Use **Me → Settings → Delete learning data**, or delete the app. Your data lives only on your iPhone, so this removes it completely.

tracking_detail: After you finish the welcome screens, iOS asks whether Firstalk may track you (App Tracking Transparency). We advertise Firstalk with Google Ads. Only if you tap **Allow**, Google Analytics for Firebase receives your device's advertising identifier (IDFA), and app installs, the start of a free trial and Firstalk Pro purchases (product and price) are shared with Google Ads so we can tell which of our ads brought new learners. Google also uses on-device conversion measurement, which matches an ad to an install on your iPhone without sending your name, email or phone number — Firstalk never collects these. If you tap **Ask App Not to Track**, no IDFA is collected; Apple's AdAttributionKit and Apple Ads attribution may still tell us or the ad network that an ad led to an install, without identifying you or your device (see above). You can change this any time in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking. What you say in speaking exercises is never used for this.
